title: Denying native Edit/Write is CODEX-only mechanism
desc: T1 core: denying native Edit and Write is a CODEX-ONLY mechanism (see codex-tool-wrappers); never inject an Edit or Write deny into a Claude .claude settings file. Hardcoded pace and opus-budget guard logic outranks CLAUDE.md harness:safe rules; guard order puts pace and opus-budget before spec-gate. Implementation: native-tool-deny-codex-only-howto. Incident history: native-tool-deny-codex-only-ref.
steps: CONCEPT: denying native Edit and Write is a CODEX-ONLY mechanism. Codex cannot run the wkharness PreToolUse hook, so its native tools are blocked to FORCE routing through Claude-named cmd wrappers (see codex-tool-wrappers). This deny MUST target Codex config, NEVER the Claude Code per-repo .claude settings file.

HARD RULE: never inject an Edit or Write deny into a Claude .claude settings file. It disables Claude Code own Edit and Write for the whole repo, for every model including Opus, and cheap models then flail to fake progress. Deny-as-routing backfires on same-family Claude models.

PRINCIPLE: hardcoded pace and opus-budget guard logic OUTRANKS declarative CLAUDE.md harness:safe rules. A harness:safe rule CANNOT exempt an Edit or Write from the pace guard; the pace guard exempts only memory md files and the rules MD by hardcoded logic. To edit other files while over-target use wkappbot file edit or wkcodex.

GUARD ORDER: check pace and opus-budget BEFORE spec-gate and agent-brief-guard, so an over-target Opus spawn is denied up front instead of a cheap model satisfying spec-gate to break through the budget. The harness never spawns Opus itself.
RULES-MD is post-review, never deny-intercept: a rules-MD change fires a NON-blocking Opus review after the fact; blocking it makes cheap models read tool-disabled and flail.

NAVIGATION: implementation (correct Codex impl, cmd wrappers, guard-order impl, over-target allow-list, rules-MD review) is in native-tool-deny-codex-only-howto. Dated incident history (2026-05-27 settings pollution, 2026-06-25 consume-allow-once, 2026-06-29 approval-loop fix and authoritative Codex deny contract, 2026-07-03 TODO principles, 2026-07 Get-CodexToolName consolidation) is in native-tool-deny-codex-only-ref.
See also: codex-tool-wrappers (correct Codex routing impl), wkharness-guards (guard reference), claude-md-harness-rules (declarative rule syntax).
